name: Databases
author: Saeed
description: Read (and, if you allow it, change) the data of company systems directly from their database, without opening the program. Works with SQL Server, any ODBC source (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQLite...) and OLE DB (Access, Excel). Windows only.

tools.name: connections
tools.description: List the database connections that are set up (names only).

tools.name: tables
tools.description: List the tables of a connection, or the columns of one table.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run ONE read-only SELECT statement and return the rows (default 200, max 2000). Look at tables first; do not guess column names.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run ONE INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE statement. Always include a WHERE for UPDATE and DELETE. Tell the user what changed.

settings.label: Connections, one per line:  name | kind | connection string   (kind: sqlserver, odbc, oledb). Use {{secret:NAME}} for passwords.
